title: spermacoce thymifolia
intro: Spermacoce thymifolia, commonly known as Yellow Buttons, is a plant species that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. It is a herbaceous perennial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Spermacoce thymifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating respiratory issues. The plant's health benefits include its ability to boost the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit potential anticancer properties.
